author: Karl Rock
description:
Today I'm taking you to one of Pakistan's most unique breakfast dishes... the famous Dulhan Paratha (Bride Paratha) at Afzal Cafe in the historic Shahi Bazaar of Hyderabad, Sindh.

At first glance it looks like an elaborate wedding platter, but it's actually a single paratha transformed into one of the most over-the-top breakfasts you'll ever see. Café Afzal has been serving this iconic dish for around 50 years, and people travel from across Sindh just to try it. Hidden away in the narrow streets of Hyderabad's old city, this small café has become famous for creating a breakfast unlike anything else.

So what exactly is a Dulhan Paratha?

It all starts with a freshly cooked paratha, which is then loaded with an incredible variety of toppings and fillings. The version I tried included spicy beef mince, shredded chicken, chopped onions, fresh coriander, green chillies, eggs, cream, crunchy cashew nuts, and a generous sprinkle of chaat masala and spices before being beautifully decorated
title: Would You Marry This Pakistani Bride?
